verdict.rationale: Clerk documents first-party M2M tokens that authenticate calls between agents, and API keys for programmatic callers such as scripts, cron jobs and partner backends. Its pricing page lists 'Machine Authentication — API Keys & M2M Tokens' as a metered platform feature, so backend services and agents can authenticate without a human. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that issuance follows the OAuth client-credentials grant, detail on the token issuance and verification flow beyond one-line summaries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
